title: Non-existence probabilities and lower tails in the critical regime via Belief Propagation
summary: We compute the logarithmic asymptotics of the non-existence probability (and more generally the lower-tail probability) for a wide variety of combinatorial problems for a range of parameters in the `critical regime' between the regime amenable to hypergraph container methods and that amenable to Janson's inequality. Examples include lower tails and non-existence probabilities for subgraphs of random graphs and for $k$-term arithmetic progressions in random sets of integers.
